<?php
// E2E probe (test only): emulates what WooCommerce Subscriptions / Pre-Orders do to the block checkout.
// They register an extra "payment requirement" ('subscriptions' / 'pre-orders') for carts that contain such a product, and the
// Checkout block then only offers payment methods whose supported features include every requirement.
add_action( 'woocommerce_blocks_loaded', function () {
	if ( ! function_exists( 'woocommerce_store_api_register_payment_requirements' ) ) { return; }
	woocommerce_store_api_register_payment_requirements( array(
		'data_callback' => function () {
			$req = array();
			if ( function_exists( 'WC' ) && WC()->cart ) {
				foreach ( WC()->cart->get_cart() as $item ) {
					$name = isset( $item['data'] ) ? $item['data']->get_name() : '';
					if ( false !== strpos( $name, 'E2E Subscription' ) ) { $req[] = 'subscriptions'; }
					if ( false !== strpos( $name, 'E2E Preorder' ) ) { $req[] = 'pre-orders'; }
				}
			}
			return array_values( array_unique( $req ) );
		},
	) );
} );
// Stub the plugins' main classes when the test switches them on (never on a normal site), to check the admin notice.
if ( 'yes' === get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_subs' ) && ! class_exists( 'WC_Subscriptions' ) ) { class WC_Subscriptions {} }
if ( 'yes' === get_option( 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_preorders' ) && ! class_exists( 'WC_Pre_Orders' ) ) { class WC_Pre_Orders {} }
add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) ) { return; }
	$mode = sanitize_key( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] );
	$map  = array( 'subs_on' => array( 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_subs', 'yes' ), 'subs_off' => array( 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_subs', 'no' ), 'pre_on' => array( 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_preorders', 'yes' ), 'pre_off' => array( 'cardz3n_e2e_stub_preorders', 'no' ) );
	if ( isset( $map[ $mode ] ) ) { update_option( $map[ $mode ][0], $map[ $mode ][1] ); header( 'Content-Type: application/json' ); echo wp_json_encode( array( 'ok' => true ) ); exit; }
}, 20 );

<?php
// E2E probe (test only): reports the Blocks default, the compatibility declarations and the one-time migration.
add_action( 'wp_loaded', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] ) ) { return; }
	$mode = sanitize_key( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e'] );
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	$opt  = cardz3n_gw_settings_option_key();
	$base = 'cardz3n-gateway/cardz3n-gateway-woocommerce.php';
	$enabled = function () use ( $opt ) {
		if ( function_exists( 'cardz3n_gw_native_blocks_enabled' ) ) { return cardz3n_gw_native_blocks_enabled(); }
		$s = get_option( $opt, array() ); // Older code: on only when explicitly saved as yes.
		return is_array( $s ) && isset( $s['enable_experimental_blocks_checkout'] ) && 'yes' === $s['enable_experimental_blocks_checkout'];
	};
	$migrate = function () { if ( function_exists( 'cardz3n_gw_maybe_migrate_settings' ) ) { cardz3n_gw_maybe_migrate_settings(); } };
	$compat = function ( $feature ) use ( $base ) {
		$r = \Automattic\WooCommerce\Utilities\FeaturesUtil::get_compatible_plugins_for_feature( $feature );
		return array(
			'compatible'   => in_array( $base, (array) ( $r['compatible'] ?? array() ), true ),
			'incompatible' => in_array( $base, (array) ( $r['incompatible'] ?? array() ), true ),
		);
	};
	if ( 'state' === $mode ) {
		$s = get_option( $opt, array() );
		echo wp_json_encode( array(
			'enabled'      => $enabled(),
			'saved_value'  => is_array( $s ) && isset( $s['enable_experimental_blocks_checkout'] ) ? $s['enable_experimental_blocks_checkout'] : null,
			'flag'         => (bool) get_option( 'cardz3n_gw_blocks_default_applied' ),
			'blocks'       => $compat( 'cart_checkout_blocks' ),
			'hpos'         => $compat( 'custom_order_tables' ),
		) );
		exit;
	}
	if ( 'migrate_existing' === $mode ) {
		// An existing store: saved gateway settings, no value for the Blocks setting, migration not yet run.
		update_option( $opt, array( 'enabled' => 'yes', 'test_mode' => 'yes' ) );
		delete_option( 'cardz3n_gw_blocks_default_applied' );
		$migrate();
		$s = get_option( $opt, array() );
		echo wp_json_encode( array( 'saved_value' => $s['enable_experimental_blocks_checkout'] ?? null, 'enabled' => $enabled(), 'flag' => (bool) get_option( 'cardz3n_gw_blocks_default_applied' ) ) );
		exit;
	}
	if ( 'migrate_fresh' === $mode ) {
		// A fresh install: nothing saved yet, migration not yet run.
		delete_option( $opt );
		delete_option( 'cardz3n_gw_blocks_default_applied' );
		$migrate();
		$s = get_option( $opt, array() );
		echo wp_json_encode( array( 'saved_value' => is_array( $s ) && isset( $s['enable_experimental_blocks_checkout'] ) ? $s['enable_experimental_blocks_checkout'] : null, 'enabled' => $enabled(), 'flag' => (bool) get_option( 'cardz3n_gw_blocks_default_applied' ) ) );
		exit;
	}
	if ( 'switch_on' === $mode ) {
		$s = get_option( $opt, array() );
		$s['enable_experimental_blocks_checkout'] = 'yes';
		update_option( $opt, $s );
		echo wp_json_encode( array( 'ok' => true ) );
		exit;
	}
	if ( 'switch_off' === $mode ) {
		$s = get_option( $opt, array() );
		$s['enable_experimental_blocks_checkout'] = 'no';
		update_option( $opt, $s );
		echo wp_json_encode( array( 'ok' => true ) );
		exit;
	}
	exit;
}, 20 );
